messages.content: Who is currently the top ranked tennis player?

function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

message.content:
I’m sorry—I don’t have direct access to a live database of current ATP/WTA rankings right now, so I can’t give you the exact name of the #1 player today. Rankings change frequently based on recent tournament results, and without a dedicated “player_ranking” endpoint or a reliable third‑party API call, I can’t pull the most up‑to‑date information automatically.

If you’re looking for the latest standings, here’s what you can do:

| Option | How to get it |
|--------|---------------|
| **Official ATP / WTA websites** | Visit <https://www.atptour.com> or <https://www.wtatennis.com>, where they publish weekly updated leaderboards. |
| **Sports news sites** | ESPN, BBC Sport, Tennis.com often report on the current #1 when there’s a significant shift. |
| **Mobile apps** | Official ATP & WTA apps show live rankings and notifications about changes. |

Let me know if you'd like help navigating those resources or if you want historical context around who has held the top spot over the past few years!
